Median and 95th percentile cover every r: Median and 95th percentile cover every recorded request, including those answered from the cache. Candidates and phases cover only the requests the engine calculated. Retrieval is analyzing the entry and finding candidate targets; loading is reading the targets or sources; phrases is looking for where to place the anchor; scoring is rating each one. Sorting, reasons and removing ignored words are not in any phase, and the phases are medians, so they do not have to add up to the total.
